name: Mary, Queen of Scots memorial

layers.essential_history: [[c:A memorial near the castle mound remembers Mary, Queen of Scots. Her body stayed in the village for months after her execution before burial at Peterborough Cathedral.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:She was later moved to Westminster Abbey by her son, James I.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Hidden under a stone you find a scrap of a merchant's bill, written in numbers.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The merchant's bill]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:A is 1, B is 2, C is 3, and so on.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Where was the rose hidden? (one word)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:2 1 18 18 5 12 spells BARREL. The rose is hidden in a wine barrel.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

directions_to_next: [[c:Back up the lane to Main Street, turn left and walk up past the church to the Falcon. About 640 metres.]]
